title: OMR Lab benchmark manifest
description: The samples of one benchmark set: where each input and its ground truth are, their checksums, source, license, condition and exclusions; see docs/benchmark.md. Sample ids must also be unique, which the loader checks.

schema_version.description: Version of this contract. Changes to the contract require a new schema file and version.

name.description: Optional short name of the benchmark set, copied into reports.

description.description: Optional free text about the set.

samples.description: The samples, in the order they are run and reported.

id.description: Stable sample identifier, unique in the manifest; also the name of the sample's run directory.

image.description: Input image or PDF, relative to the manifest's directory.

ground_truth.description: MusicXML ground truth relative to the manifest's directory, or null when the sample has none.

source.description: Where the input and ground truth come from.

license.description: License of the sample files, preferably an SPDX identifier.

condition.description: Input condition, such as 'clean digital rendering' or 'phone photo, skewed'.

renderer.description: Optional tools used to produce a synthetic image.

excluded.description: Present when the sample is kept in the manifest but not run; reports list it with the reason.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the file.

manifestPath.description: A POSIX-style path relative to the manifest's directory; '..' segments are allowed.

allOf.description: must not contain control characters such as newlines or tabs
must be relative, not start with '/'
must use '/' as the separator, not '\'
must not start with a drive letter such as 'C:'
